answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 35130 Country: India Title: Can a woman or man do zikr in the state of impurity Question: Can a woman or man do zikr in the state of impurity? If we can do zikr then what kind of zikr can be performed while impurity, may it be sexual intercourse or ejaculation or monthly menstruation of women. Kindly explain in detail. May Allah reward you His blessings in both the worlds. Answer ID: 35130 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1699/1168/L=1432) A man in the state of janabah as well as a woman in the state of janabah or her menstruating period can do all types of zikr except the recitation of the holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
